summary: Require complete local agent source links for the selected repository layout

delivery.outcome: Reject incomplete, unsafe or omitted declared local source links in the selected hub/adopter layout, preserving valid complete layouts and publishing immutable standard 0.20.69.
nonGoals: Change remote link execution or authority
Change bootstrap copying or effectful controller

architecture.decision: Bind the required local source set to the selected canonical host-contract location, not to whichever manifest happens to exist. Require all applicable declared local files to be safe regular checkout files and visible in each host projection. Keep inactive-layout links optional.
interfaceChanges: Preserve report shape; extend the source-link helper with optional selected-contract context for explicit contract callers.
architecture.rollback: Revert the material source fix through protected publication; preserve controller and review receipts.

validation.evidence: Temporary hub and adopter fixtures reproduce incomplete-set acceptance; complete layouts pass, missing/omitted/symlinked local files fail, inactive-layout paths remain optional.
Existing validator integration, parity, native gate and required exact-head Linux/Windows/OneDev checks pass.
Independent protected merge and final immutable standard v0.20.69 publication are verified.
